title: Team task board
prompt: Build a task board web app called "Orbit". It shows three columns -- Todo, In Progress, Done -- each holding task cards. Seed it with six tasks spread across the columns; each card shows a title, an assignee name, and a priority badge (High, Medium, or Low). There is an "Add task" button at the top right. The header reads "Orbit" with the subtitle "Sprint 14". Use a clean light theme.

rubric.description: The page shows a real interface, not a blank page, a loading spinner, or an error overlay.
A header is visible reading "Orbit", with "Sprint 14" nearby as a subtitle.
Three distinct columns are laid out side by side, labelled Todo, In Progress and Done.
At least four task cards are visible, distributed across more than one column.
Task cards show an assignee name and a priority badge, not just a bare title.
An "Add task" button is visible near the top right of the page.
The layout is deliberately styled -- spacing, colour and alignment look designed rather than default browser output.

iterations.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('header') || document.querySelector('[class*=header]') || document.body.firstElementChild; if (!el) return false; const m = getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor.match(/\d+/g); if (!m) return false; const [r,g,b] = m.map(Number); return b > 90 && b > r + 25 && b > g + 15; })()

iterations.prompt: Add a fourth column called "Blocked" after Done.
iterations.description: A structural edit, not just a style token.
